title: ci: add rollback and secret sync to the manual legacy deploy
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The manual legacy Cloudflare cache deploy workflow now accepts `worker=both/text/image` to target the text and image Workers. A validated version ID can roll back one Worker with `wrangler versions deploy <id>@100% -y`. A separate `sync_secrets` option pushes `GEN_API_KEY` and `WEFT_SELLER_API_KEY` from `LEGACY_*` GitHub secrets using `wrangler secret bulk`, printing secret names but not values. Secret sync is restricted to runs from `production`, targets one Worker per run, and cannot be combined with a version rollback. Runs from branches other than `main` or `production` now fail explicitly. With `worker=both`, text and image test and deploy in independent parallel jobs with fail-fast disabled, so an image test failure no longer blocks the text deploy. Cloudflare credentials are limited to steps that call Wrangler, and workflow concurrency uses `queue: max`. The workflow remains manual, with no push trigger.
